## 🚀 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see in Bid2Ride.

## 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear description of what the problem is. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Details
Describe how you imagine this feature working, including affected layers (e.g. FastAPI backend endpoint, React component, Socket.IO event, PostGIS table).

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🎨 Mockups / Wireframes (Optional)
If applicable, attach UI mockups or diagram sketches.

## 👥 Target Audience
- [ ] Passengers
- [ ] Drivers
- [ ] Platform Administrators
- [ ] System Maintainers / Developers

## ❓ Additional Context
Add any other context or references about the feature request here.
